Hello Javina. We are sorry that you were disappointed in your experience with Quello. We pride ourselves on creating an experience that exceeds the expectations of it’s patients, we take your feedback seriously. After reviewing the messaging you were sent and that you have posted to this review site, our position is still consistent that because of a lack of proactive communication, we cannot refund you for the medication. We sent multiple notifications prior to charging your card and billed you at correct 3-month increment, consistent with treatment consent form. We understand your frustration in the matter but because the medication is custom mixed, unless there has been a shipping or other delivery error, we are unable to take them back and supply a refund.
